item.title: Tree outside 76b princess road, 3rd August
item.description:
Watched with my own eyes this young woman let her large black dog foul and walked away. She watched her dog do it and simply walked off. We asked her to pick it up and she ignored us and kept walking. You can smell it a number of doors down and it has attracted many flies. People need to be fined for this disgusting behaviour. They shouldn't own dogs if they can't take care of them or have basic hygiene and respect for others.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Princess Road, London
